verdicts.reason: Both split the design awkwardly. The headline 'Traditional Ceramics Workshop' sits small at the top right, while the dashed tagline block takes the left side. This breaks the reading order and leaves the headline less prominent than the tagline. A is worse: its booking/website lines are tiny and nearly illegible, and 'Great location…' nearly touches 'creativity.' B keeps the contact copy readable and leaves a clearer gutter, but it still has an uneven top margin, an orphaned headline and big empty bands.
